sourcesRead.what: App Store product page: compatibility, languages, platforms
Version history 2.5.2 (2025-11-06) to 3.1.16 (2026-10-02), from fac-repo/data/releases/hevy.json, all read
All 89 help-centre articles read via the Zendesk API
Features index + all 48 /features/ pages from features-sitemap.xml
Scanned all 118 blog post URLs for product announcements; the rest are training guides
Google Play listing (Android + Wear OS availability only)

claims.detail: Log sets, reps and weight for each exercise in a live workout.
claims.quote: Track your lifts with an intuitive, simple to use interface.

claims.detail: Begin an unplanned workout and add exercises as you go.
claims.quote: Start an Empty Workout Go to the workout tab at the bottom of the app Tap "+ Start Empty Workout"

claims.detail: Create saved workout templates (routines) and start a workout from one.
claims.quote: Create a routine by adding exercises, sets, and any other details.

claims.detail: Organise routines into named folders, reorder and move routines between them by drag and drop.
claims.quote: You can create folders in the workout tab to organize your routines in your workout plan.

claims.detail: Copy an existing routine as the basis of a new one.
claims.quote: Open the Workout tab. Tap the three dots beside the routine. Select Duplicate Routine.

claims.detail: After a workout that changed a routine's structure, choose to apply the changes to the routine or keep the original.
claims.quote: you'll see a choice at the end to either "Update Routine" or "Keep Original Routine."

claims.detail: Routine weight/rep values update from the latest workout unless switched off on the save screen.
claims.quote: Routine values are always updated unless you adjust the settings on the "save workout" screen.

claims.detail: Set a rep range (e.g. 8-12) instead of a fixed rep target per set.
claims.quote: Selecting Rep Range allows you to choose two values--for instance, 8 to 12 reps.

claims.detail: Log time for duration exercises such as planks.
claims.quote: Duration-based activities like planks come with a single TIME column, where you can write a duration target for each set.

claims.detail: Log distance and duration for cardio exercises like running or rowing.
claims.quote: distance & duration (e.g., rowing), or weight & distance (e.g., suitcase carry).

claims.detail: Log bodyweight reps exercises; bodyweight is counted in volume for full-bodyweight movements.
claims.quote: If you've entered your bodyweight in the app, the app will use that value for exercises that rely on 100 percent of your bodyweight as resistance.

claims.detail: Log assistance weight that is subtracted from bodyweight for volume.
claims.quote: If the exercise uses 100 percent of your bodyweight, the app will include bodyweight in volume and also subtract the amount of assistance.

claims.detail: Log added load (vest, belt) on top of bodyweight.
claims.quote: For exercises that use 100 percent of your bodyweight, the app includes your bodyweight and the extra weight you add.

claims.detail: Log a new bodyweight from inside an active workout.
claims.quote: During a workout, tap the three dots on an exercise that uses 100 percent of your bodyweight Tap Update Bodyweight

claims.detail: Functional exercises for hybrid/HYROX-style training added to the library.
claims.quote: We've added some functional exercises to prepare for your next HYROX competition. You can now track your hybrid trainings right inside Hevy.

claims.detail: Mark a set as a warm-up set.
claims.quote: Mark sets as Warmup, Normal, Drop sets, Failure and Supersets

claims.detail: Mark a set as a drop set; rest timer does not start before a drop set.
claims.quote: To add a drop set to a workout, tap the set number, then select 'D-Dropset'

claims.detail: Mark a set as taken to failure.
claims.quote: To add a failure set, tap the set number, then select 'F - Failure set'

claims.feature: Rest timer skipped before drop sets
claims.detail: The automatic rest timer does not start when the next set is a drop set.
claims.quote: If you add a rest timer to an exercise, the timer will not start if the next set is a dropset.

claims.detail: Pair two or more exercises back-to-back as a superset; each superset is colour-coded.
claims.quote: Hevy allows you to effortlessly create as many supersets as you want while logging a live session at the gym or creating a routine.

claims.detail: Add three or more exercises to one superset to run a circuit or interval-style workout.
claims.quote: You can limit your supersets to two exercises or add multiple movements to the same superset, essentially creating a circuit.

claims.detail: Automatically scroll to the next exercise in a superset when a set is checked.
claims.quote: When enabled, Hevy automatically scrolls to the next exercise of a superset when you mark a set as complete.

claims.detail: Drag-and-drop exercise order and swap an exercise for another from the library.
claims.quote: Reorder exercises through drag-and-drop Replace the exercise by choosing a different one from the library

claims.detail: Adding a previously done exercise pre-fills its sets, weight and reps.
claims.quote: When you add an exercise you've done before, the number of sets, the weight, and the reps you've done before are automatically added, but you can adjust them.

claims.detail: Shows last time's weight and reps beside each set while logging.
claims.quote: your previous performance values appear on the left side under the column labelled Previous.

claims.detail: Choose whether previous values come from any workout or only the same routine.
claims.quote: Any workout: Your previous values will be retrieved from the last time you completed the exercise, regardless of the routine. Same Routine:

claims.detail: Tap the previous value to copy it into the current set.
claims.quote: you can tap on a previous value to instantly add it to your current workout instead of writing the load and reps or duration on each set.

claims.detail: Log Rate of Perceived Exertion (6-10 incl. half points) per set; shown with previous values next time.
claims.quote: You can tap the RPE button for a specific set to select a value from 6 to 10.

claims.detail: Logging RPE automatically marks the set as complete.
claims.quote: Improved Log RPE experience with enhanced UI feedback and automatic set checking.

claims.detail: Set rows show RPE on a colour scale.
claims.quote: Redesigned the Set Row UI - clearer active/checked states, an RPE color scale

claims.detail: Persistent per-exercise notes in a routine that show every time it is used, with clickable links.
claims.quote: Routine notes - you can add these to any exercise while building a routine (reusable workout template). They will appear with their respective exercises each time you use the routine to log a workout.

claims.detail: Routine notes can contain a clickable link, e.g. to a video.
claims.quote: You can include a link that's clickable when reviewing the routine or logging it as a live workout.

claims.detail: One-off notes on an exercise for a single session, saved with the workout.
claims.quote: Workout notes - these are the notes you can write for specific exercises while logging a session.

claims.detail: Name a workout and add a description when saving.
claims.quote: Write a description - write a note with feedback, observations, or even an update for people who follow you on Hevy.

claims.detail: Mention other users with @ in a workout description.
claims.quote: You can also tag people by adding @ and writing the person's name.

claims.detail: Tag the gym where a workout took place.
claims.quote: Tag your GYM on your workouts - let everyone see where the work gets done!

claims.detail: Throw away a workout in progress.
claims.quote: You can click the Discard Workout button at the bottom in case you can't finish a session you've started.

claims.detail: Pause and resume the workout duration clock (phone only).
claims.quote: Tap 'Pause Workout Timer' 3. Once you are ready to resume, tap the duration once again, then tap 'Resume Workout Timer'

claims.detail: Change a workout's duration on save or afterwards.
claims.quote: Select 'Duration' and a scroll list will appear

claims.detail: Change start date and time to log a past workout.
claims.quote: Adjust the start date and time (if logging a previously completed workout)

claims.detail: Edit sets, exercises, duration, media and visibility of a saved workout.
claims.quote: Tap the three dots next to a saved workout and select Edit Workout to change its details

claims.detail: Delete a saved workout, or swipe to delete a set.
claims.quote: How to delete a set 1. Swipe left on the set 2. Tap the delete button that appears on the right side of the set

claims.detail: Start a new live workout pre-filled from a past workout (own or another user's).
claims.quote: Select a past workout from you or from another user Tap the 3 dots in the top right-hand corner of the screen

claims.detail: Turn any completed workout (own or someone else's) into a routine.
claims.quote: Tap the three dots on the top right of any workout and select Save as Routine .

claims.detail: Log more than one workout on the same date.
claims.quote: Can I log more than one workout in a single day? Yes.

claims.detail: Running volume and completed-set count shown during a workout.
claims.quote: Next to the stopwatch, you can monitor your volume load and the number of completed sets .

claims.detail: Muscle distribution heatmap visible during an active workout.
claims.quote: You can now view a muscle distribution heatmap while logging your workout-tap it to see full details.

claims.detail: Open an exercise's instructions/stats mid-workout without leaving it.
claims.quote: You can also access this and the other sections while logging a workout by tapping on any movement's name. Doing so won't pause or discard the session.

claims.detail: Make an individual workout private.
claims.quote: On the screen before saving the workout, where you can add a photo, tap Visibility. Select Private.

claims.detail: Set all new workouts to private (or public) by default.
claims.quote: Select Default Workout Visibility. Select Private.

claims.detail: Rest countdown starts automatically when a set is checked.
claims.quote: When enabled for an exercise, the countdown starts automatically when you mark a set as complete.

claims.detail: Different rest duration per exercise (5 s to 5 min).
claims.quote: Customize automatic rest timers for each exercise

claims.detail: Global default rest duration applied to newly added exercises.
claims.quote: A default rest timer automatically applies your chosen duration to new exercises you add to a workout or routine.

claims.detail: Add or remove 15 seconds from a running rest timer.
claims.quote: During your rest period, use +15 to add 15 seconds

claims.detail: Choose from 5 timer sounds and set timer volume (high/normal/low/off).
claims.quote: Timer Sound Choose from 5 different timer sounds

claims.detail: Adjust the volume of the sound played when a set is checked.
claims.quote: Check Set The volume of the sound played when you mark a set as complete.

claims.detail: Push notification when the rest timer ends.
claims.quote: Rest Timer Receive a notification when your rest timer finishes.

claims.detail: Start/stop stopwatch inside duration-exercise sets that records the time.
claims.quote: Inline Timer Duration exercises include a built-in stopwatch to track the time of each set.

claims.detail: Separate countdown timer from the workout clock icon that alerts at zero.
claims.quote: Tap the clock icon at the top of the workout Choose 'Timer' Input the duration of the exercise When the timer reaches 0 it will use the same sound that you hear for the rest timer

claims.detail: Prevent the phone from sleeping during a workout.
claims.quote: Keep Awake During Workout This feature keeps your phone on during an active workout.

claims.detail: Shows which plates to load on a bar for a target weight, with custom bars/plates and closest-possible weight.
claims.quote: you can input the weight you want and the plates you have available, and the plate calculator will let you know how to load your barbell to achieve that weight

claims.detail: Add custom bar and plate weights to the plate calculator.
claims.quote: Tap '+ Custom Bar' to add a custom bar size Tap '+ Custom Plate' to add a custom plate size

claims.detail: Plate calculator extended to Smith-machine hip thrust.
claims.quote: Plate Calculator is now available for Hip Thrust (Smith Machine) - quickly calculate your plate setup

claims.detail: Insert percentage-based warm-up sets for a target weight, with editable formula and plate/dumbbell rounding.
claims.quote: Hevy's warm-up calculator allows you to adjust some settings and more quickly add percentage-based warm-up sets to exercises

claims.detail: Toggle whether warm-up sets count toward totals, volume and PRs.
claims.quote: Warm-up Sets When enabled, this feature includes warm-up sets in your workout statistics (Total sets, volume, and personal records).

claims.detail: Estimates 1RM from logged sets using a rep-percentage table.
claims.quote: Calculation of One Rep Max for all strength exercises

claims.detail: Choose weight, distance and body-measurement units globally.
claims.quote: From here, you can set the preferred units for weight, distance and body measurements

claims.detail: Override kg/lb for a single exercise.
claims.quote: You can also change the unit of measurement used for weight for specific exercises.

claims.detail: Choose which day the week/calendar starts on.
claims.quote: First Day of the Week This will set the day of the week the calendar begins.

claims.detail: Dark appearance.
claims.quote: Dark Mode

claims.detail: Haptic feedback on interactions.
claims.quote: more haptic feedback, a smoother dark mode experience

claims.detail: Muscle heatmap figure follows the profile's sex; female assets added.
claims.quote: Female assets for muscle distribution!

claims.detail: App available in English and 15 other languages.
claims.quote: English, Arabic, Catalan, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish

claims.detail: App contains no advertising.
claims.quote: No ads and free.

claims.detail: Built-in library of 400+ exercises with equipment and muscle filters and search.
claims.quote: Hevy's library has 400+ high-quality exercises.

claims.detail: Exercises include demonstration videos/animations.
claims.quote: Hundreds of exercises with free high-quality videos for you to focus on your form

claims.detail: Written setup and execution instructions per exercise.
claims.quote: Step-by-step instructions on proper setup and execution

claims.detail: Create your own exercises with equipment, primary/secondary muscles, type and image/video.
claims.quote: Create your own custom exercises for your workouts

claims.detail: Attach a photo, video or GIF to a custom exercise.
claims.quote: change the asset (you can add a photo, video, or GIF)

claims.detail: Copy a library exercise into a new custom one (e.g. per machine or to reset history).
claims.quote: Select Duplicate Exercise and add a clarification in the name

claims.detail: Weight & reps, bodyweight, weighted/assisted bodyweight, duration, duration & weight, distance & duration, weight & distance.
claims.quote: You can choose between weight & reps (e.g., bench press), bodyweight reps (e.g., pull-ups), weighted bodyweight (e.g., weighted dips), assisted bodyweight (e.g., assisted pull-ups), duration (e.g., plank)

claims.detail: 26 ready-made programs filterable by level, goal and equipment, saved as routine folders.
claims.quote: Hevy has a pre-built library of 26 training programs and seven routine categories.

claims.detail: Single-workout categories: at home, travel, dumbbells only, band, cardio & HIIT, gym, bodyweight.
claims.quote: At home Travel Dumbbells only Band Cardio & HIIT Gym Bodyweight

claims.detail: Open routines linked in blog articles and save them to your library.
claims.quote: If you click this link, it will bring you to the routine and you can save it to your library from there.

claims.detail: Algorithmic program generated from goal, experience, equipment, frequency, duration and focus muscle.
claims.quote: Hevy Trainer is a new feature for Hevy Pro users that will provide a workout program based on your goals and preferences.

claims.detail: Tells you when and how much to increase weight based on performance.
claims.quote: Hevy Trainer has a progressive overload feature that will let you know when to increase your weight and by how much based on your performance.

claims.detail: Progressive overload supports bodyweight reps-only exercises.
claims.quote: Progressive Overload now supports reps-only exercises (pull-ups, push-ups, etc.)

claims.detail: Recommended starting weights for exercises logged before.
claims.quote: Suggested starting weights for new exercises ( when you've logged the exercise at least once before )

claims.detail: Prompts to push harder when progression stalls.
claims.quote: Gentle reminders to maintain intensity if progress stalls

claims.detail: Weekly consistency, exercise progress, sets per body part vs recommended range, weekly average bodyweight.
claims.quote: you can view your trainer progression using the Progress Report, exclusive to Hevy Trainer

claims.detail: Shows sets per body part and whether you are in the recommended (green) range.
claims.quote: a chart showing the number of sets per body part, and if you fall into the recommended (green) range

claims.detail: See the entire generated program at a glance.
claims.quote: You can now see your full Trainer program!

claims.detail: Each generated workout shows exercise count, estimated duration and preview.
claims.quote: Each Trainer workout includes an overview: the number of exercises, the estimated duration, and a preview of the workout.

claims.detail: Add, remove, swap or reorder exercises in the next generated workout.
claims.quote: Trainer also allows you to make adjustments, such as adding, removing, swapping, or rearranging exercises.

claims.detail: Replacing an exercise offers four recommended alternatives.
claims.quote: choose from four suitable alternatives recommended by Trainer at the top

claims.detail: Swap an exercise for just one session or for all future workouts.
claims.quote: When swapping exercises, Trainer asks if the change should be permanent or apply only to the current session.

claims.detail: Mark exercises 'Don't recommend again' and manage the exclusion list.
claims.quote: The Excluded Exercises setting contains exercises that you do not want Trainer to recommend.

claims.detail: Flag injured body areas so the program avoids or warns on aggravating exercises.
claims.quote: Injury Management lets you flag injuries so Trainer can adapt your program around them.

claims.detail: Control how often program exercises rotate (consistent, ~6-weekly, weekly).
claims.quote: Program Variety setting lets you control how often your Trainer exercises change.

claims.detail: Equipment presets (home, garage, commercial, large gym) or custom, incl. available dumbbell/plate/bar weights.
claims.quote: You can now choose more granular equipments for trainer programs!

claims.detail: Specify exact dumbbell, plate and bar weights you own for program suggestions.
claims.quote: Tap Dumbbells to select your available dumbbell weights. Tap Plates to select your available plate weights. Tap Barbell to select your available bar weights.

claims.detail: Choose a muscle group to emphasise in the generated program.
claims.quote: The Focus Muscle Group setting allows you to choose a muscle group that you want to emphasize in your program.

claims.detail: Set the desired length of generated workouts.
claims.quote: The Workout Duration setting controls the desired estimated length of each Trainer workout.

claims.detail: Short/medium/long default rest for generated workouts.
claims.quote: you can now change the default rest timer, with shorter and longer options to match how you train.

claims.detail: Add cardio at the start or end of generated workouts, or disable it.
claims.quote: You can: Disable cardio. Add cardio at the beginning of your workout. Add cardio at the end of your workout.

claims.detail: Choose Full Body, Upper/Lower or Push/Pull/Legs for the program.
claims.quote: Switch up your split: Full Body, Upper/Lower, Push Pull Legs and more - your training, your call.

claims.detail: Gain strength, build muscle or fat loss goal shapes rep ranges.
claims.quote: Available goals: Gain Strength Build Muscle Fat Loss

claims.detail: Beginner, intermediate or advanced level for the program.
claims.quote: Available options: Beginner Intermediate Advanced

claims.detail: Choose 1-6 workouts per week; default split follows.
claims.quote: The Frequency setting controls how many Trainer workouts you are assigned each week.

claims.detail: Program templates personalized for female athletes.
claims.quote: Female templates: better personalization for our Athletes!

claims.detail: Rearrange the order of workouts in the generated program.
claims.quote: the three dots icon opens a menu with options to rearrange the workouts or access the program's settings

claims.detail: Restart the generated program.
claims.quote: You can also restart your program.

claims.detail: Small workout tips shown in the generated program.
claims.quote: Additionally, Trainer offers small workout tips to keep you informed:

claims.detail: In-app section explaining the research behind programming decisions.
claims.quote: Scroll down a bit further, and you'll see Science Behind Hevy Trainer .

claims.detail: In-ChatGPT app (@hevy) that reads your history, analyses progress and builds plans saved to your account.
claims.quote: you can dig deeper into your training and progress, ask questions about your workout history, and create workout plans tailored to your goals, equipment, and schedule - all from ChatGPT and saved straight to your Hevy account.

claims.detail: Plans built in ChatGPT are saved directly as routines in the app.
claims.quote: Generate tailored training plans, analyze your progress and trends, or simply ask for a perfect next workout based on previous performance.

claims.detail: Send a finished workout to ChatGPT or Claude from the finish screen for feedback.
claims.quote: You can now Send workouts to ChatGPT & Claude directly from the finish workout screen!

claims.detail: Full-screen graphs of heaviest weight, 1RM, set/session volume and total reps per exercise.
claims.quote: Analyze the progression of your lifts with beautiful full-screen graphs of volume, best weight & total reps

claims.detail: Cardio exercises chart best pace, longest distance and longest time.
claims.quote: For cardio exercises, you can view your Best Pace, Longest Distance and Longest Time on the graph

claims.detail: List of every past session of an exercise with sets and weights.
claims.quote: If you navigate to an exercise and tap the History tab, you will be able to see all of the workouts you have completed for this exercise

claims.detail: PRs per exercise type: heaviest weight, best 1RM, best set/session volume, most reps, best time, longest distance.
claims.quote: Heaviest weight: The heaviest weight you've ever lifted Best 1RM:

claims.detail: Heaviest weight lifted for each rep count.
claims.quote: it displays the heaviest weight you've lifted for that specific number of repetitions.

claims.detail: Banner and sound the moment a set beats a personal record.
claims.quote: When you check off a set and achieve a Personal Record, a banner will appear letting you know what PR you have achieved.

claims.detail: Medals shown on PR sets in saved workouts.
claims.quote: a medal will appear for the set the PR was achieved and in the workout information once you have saved the workout.

claims.detail: Beginner-to-Elite rating vs users of same sex, age and bodyweight, with percentile, on selected lifts.
claims.quote: It will also let you know what percentage of people in this group you are stronger than.

claims.detail: Muscle-group breakdown of each workout session.
claims.quote: Analyze your workout sessions in detail with muscle group graphs

claims.detail: Workouts in the last 7 days with trained muscles on a body heatmap.
claims.quote: You can see how many times you've worked out in the previous seven days and what muscles you've trained during this time on the body heat map.

claims.detail: Weekly/monthly/yearly set counts per selectable muscle group.
claims.quote: This section includes a breakdown of how many sets you have done for each of the different muscle groups.

claims.detail: Volume split across muscles, compared with the previous period.
claims.quote: The muscle distribution chart allows you to see how you have divided your training volume between different muscles.

claims.detail: Sets per muscle per calendar week on a body diagram.
claims.quote: This section allows you to see the number of sets per muscle group from week to week, along with a muscle diagram

claims.detail: Your most frequent exercises over a chosen period.
claims.quote: This section provides an overview of the exercises you've logged most often in the past 30 days, three months, year, or since the start.

claims.detail: Recap of last month: workouts, duration, volume, sets, PRs, calendar, muscles, top exercises, photos.
claims.quote: This section gives you a detailed report from the last completed month.

claims.detail: Annual December recap of stats, top month, muscles, exercises, supporters, streak and PRs.
claims.quote: Every December, Hevy highlights your training stats and consistency.

claims.detail: Profile shows week-to-week time, volume and reps.
claims.quote: You'll be able to see your time spent training, volume, and number of reps from week to week.

claims.detail: Calendar of all workout days; tap a day to open or log a workout.
claims.quote: Use the calendar to stay on top of your training schedule

claims.detail: Zoom the calendar out to a whole year or all years.
claims.quote: You can now zoom out on your training and see your gym calendar for the whole year:

claims.detail: Count of consecutive weeks with at least one workout.
claims.quote: one that shows your current active streak (how many weeks in a row you have completed a workout)

claims.detail: Log a past workout in a missed week to restore the streak.
claims.quote: you can enter a past workout for that week to recover your streak.

claims.detail: Shows days since your last workout.
claims.quote: it will show you how many rest days you have had since your last completed workout.

claims.detail: Ordinal workout number and streak shown after saving.
claims.quote: Ordinal number of your workout (e.g., 472nd)

claims.detail: Fun real-world comparison of total weight lifted.
claims.quote: You lifted a total of 12 610 kg. That's like lifting a truck!

claims.feature: Watch heart rate and calories on workouts
claims.detail: Workouts recorded on a watch show average HR, HR graph and calories.
claims.quote: Hevy workouts logged on a smartwatch (WatchOS or WearOS) also include an average heart rate, a heart rate graph throughout the session, and calories burned.

claims.detail: Log weight, body fat % and 14 circumferences with graphs per measurement.
claims.quote: Hevy allows you to log weight, body fat, and 14 circumference measurements.

claims.detail: Separate left and right bicep, forearm, thigh and calf circumferences.
claims.quote: left and right bicep, left and right forearm, left and right thigh, and left and right calf.

claims.detail: Log lean body mass, read/written with Apple Health.
claims.quote: Hevy can now read and write lean body mass to Apple Health.

claims.detail: Private dated progress photos, one per day, with or without measurements.
claims.quote: Progress photos are only able to be seen by you unless you share them outside of Hevy.

claims.detail: Ghost overlay of your last photo to line up the camera.
claims.quote: If you tap this, it will add an overlay of your last taken progress photo so you can line yourself up with it to get consistent angles.

claims.detail: Compare two progress photos side by side.
claims.quote: Tap on any photo for additional options, such as to compare it to another

claims.detail: Enter measurements/photos for an earlier date.
claims.quote: you can use the scroll function to enter the correct date.

claims.detail: Follow friends and athletes and see their workouts in a home feed.
claims.quote: Follow your friend's progress by following their lifts and copying their routines

claims.detail: Feed of workouts from people you don't follow.
claims.quote: Discover Workouts from people you do not follow.

claims.detail: Recommended users to follow, can be hidden.
claims.quote: You can also find people through Suggested Athletes on the Home tab or by browsing Discover.

claims.detail: Find people by username.
claims.quote: Search for someone Home > Search icon > Enter their username

claims.detail: Find contacts using the app after phone-number verification.
claims.quote: Hevy allows you to connect your phone contacts to find people you know who are also using the app.

claims.detail: Invite via WhatsApp, Messenger, Facebook, X, contacts or a link.
claims.quote: You can invite friends from WhatsApp, Messenger, Facebook, X (Twitter), and your contact list

claims.detail: Like other users' workouts.
claims.quote: On workout posts, you can like the workout, leave a comment, or reply to other comments.

claims.detail: Comment on workouts, reply, like comments, include links.
claims.quote: You can also include links in your comments.

claims.detail: Mention users in comments with notifications.
claims.quote: Comment Mentions Receive a notification when another user mentions you in a comment.

claims.detail: Delete your comments and others' comments on your workouts.
claims.quote: You can delete your own comments on anyone's posts, and you can also delete other people's comments from your own posts.

claims.detail: Require approval of follow requests.
claims.quote: Set up your profile as a private profile or a public one

claims.detail: Turn off follow suggestions.
claims.quote: Hide suggested users Profile > Settings > Privacy & Social > Hide Suggested Users > Turn on

claims.detail: Block, unblock and report users.
claims.quote: From here, you can view your blocked users and choose to unblock them if needed.

claims.detail: Get notified whenever a specific user saves a workout.
claims.quote: Workout Notifications - get a push notification each time the user saves a workout

claims.detail: Profiles with bio, link, media, follower counts and weekly activity graph.
claims.quote: A user's profile brings together their workout history, routines, weekly activity, photos, and videos.

claims.detail: Add profile picture, name, bio and a URL.
claims.quote: Link Add a URL to your profile, such as a website or social media page.

claims.detail: See which friends also follow a profile.
claims.quote: Below the Follow button, you can see which of your friends also follow that person.

claims.detail: Browse another user's routines and save them.
claims.quote: You can scroll through the user's saved routines, tap on each for details, and save any routine you like to your library.

claims.detail: Start a workout copied from a friend's session.
claims.quote: Copy your friends' workouts

claims.detail: Side-by-side muscle split, workouts, duration, volume over 30d/3m/1y/all.
claims.quote: There is a profile comparison and then exercise comparison.

claims.detail: Compare PRs and who is stronger on a shared exercise.
claims.quote: Tap this Compare option and you will be able to see who is stronger in the given exercise and a comparison of your PRs for the exercise.

claims.detail: Rank yourself vs people you follow by heaviest lift on selected exercises.
claims.quote: The Leaderboard lets you see how you compare to the users you follow for a specific exercise.

claims.detail: Attach up to three photos or two photos + one video to a workout.
claims.quote: You can attach up to three photos, or two photos and one video, to a workout.

claims.detail: Generated share images of workouts, PRs, volume with dark/light/transparent backgrounds.
claims.quote: Choose a dark, light, or transparent background, then share the design or save it as an image.

claims.detail: Share cards directly to Instagram Stories.
claims.quote: Navigate to the screen you want to share, tap Stories , and share.

claims.detail: Share an exercise's performance and PR summary outside the app.
claims.quote: You can tap the upright arrow icon on the top right beside the three dots to share a summary of your performance and personal records for this exercise

claims.detail: Share any stats graph or weekly muscle overview.
claims.quote: You can tap the upward arrow icon on the top right to share any graph you've generated on social media or elsewhere outside Hevy.

claims.detail: Share your calendar view.
claims.quote: Tap the upright arrow icon on the top right and share your preferred gym calendar view with friends outside Hevy:

notes: Quotes are verbatim except curly apostrophes/dashes normalised to ASCII. Help-centre and feature pages carry only update timestamps, so their date is null; dated website items are blog/community posts. Conflicts between sources: (1) Leaderboard exercises - website says 38, the newer help centre lists 13; (2) Strength Level - website says deadlift/squat/bench only, help centre lists 13 lifts; (3) Workout media - one website page says four photos or three photos + video, help centre and other pages say three photos or two photos + one video (used); (4) Routine categories 7 (help) vs 8 incl. Suspension Band (website). Many claims (warm-up calculator, generated programs/'Trainer', set count per muscle, extra measurements, unlimited history/routines/custom exercises) are Pro-only; free tier: 4 routines, 7 custom exercises, 3 months history, weight+waist measurements only. Generated programs are explicitly algorithmic, not AI ('do not rely on AI'); the AI features are the ChatGPT app and send-to-ChatGPT/Claude. Garmin: help centre states integration is NOT available (Garmin rejected API access) - not claimed. Calendar cannot be used to plan future workouts (help centre). Apple Watch pause is not supported (phone only). App Store compatibility also lists Apple Vision (visionOS 1.0+) and iPod touch - this is Apple's automatic iPad-app compatibility, not a claimed native app, so not listed as a claim. Hevy Coach (trainer-side SaaS: lead forms, team management) is a separate product; only client-side capabilities in the Hevy app were claimed. Wellhub/Gympass access is subscription-related and excluded. Exercise-level notes and single vs double dumbbell logging are 'on our radar' in the July 2026 update - excluded as roadmap. Excluded as polish/redesign: Liquid Glass UI, header redesign, notification screen redesign, duration text input revert. App Store accessibility section: developer has not declared any accessibility features.
